## Resources

## Free tools from the book

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/kDL9BzjuTOyOt3d84XFu_icons8-phone-100.png)

#### **Call Auditing Tool**

A tool for managers or reps to gauge use of JOLT techniques on sales calls and understand strengths and areas of improvement.

[Get the tool](https://www.jolteffect.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148779575)

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/oLOo9bgQQSx2VNWPdwAj_icons8-user-manual-90.png)

#### **Interview Guide**

A guide for hiring sellers more likely to be strong on JOLT Effect skills, including sample interview questions and what to look for in their responses.

[Get the tool](https://www.jolteffect.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148779553)

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/sUZrt2R0uoqVjFNzzHQo_icons8-survey-90.png)

#### **Customer Win-Loss Questions**

Sample questions to decipher indecision levels in your won, lost, or no decision deals for use in win-loss surveys or interviews.

[Get the tool](https://www.jolteffect.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148779498)

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/makOwkJyRkKnTWlSgsit_icons8-questions-64.png)

#### **Coaching Guide**

New questions managers can use with their team to enhance seller self-discovery and replicate JOLT seller performance.

[Get the tool](https://www.jolteffect.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148779563)

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/Ays75o1SRsi0Yy9cz6BI_icons8-gauge-60.png)

#### **Indecision Gauge**

Use this interactive tool to measure your buyer's level of indecision and to qualify or disqualify deals based on the level of indecision.

[Get the tool](https://www.jolteffect.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148779582)

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/file-uploads/themes/2150170036/settings_images/d65b46-03f-a668-fd07-153ec5357a11_Notebook_icon.jpg)

#### **Complete Resource Guide**

To gain access to all of the free resources listed on this page in a single download, request access using the button below.

[Get all tools](https://www.jolteffect.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2150397742)

[Private course options to overcome indecision](https://www.jolteffect.com/store)

### Curious how JOLT Effect fits with other sales methodologies?

[Watch a short video](https://www.jolteffect.com/curriculum)

## Sample subscriber-only resources

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/hu91DdVsT3auj3VVw0di_file.jpg)

#### **Personalizing Recommendations for Hesitant Buyers**

![](https://kajabi-storefronts-production.kajabi-cdn.com/kajabi-storefronts-production/themes/2150170036/settings_images/kqKIX3PT1un8NMp40gpg_Screen_Shot_2022-06-24_at_11.17.12_AM.png)
